title: Ordered insertion gives a local homotopy inverse
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $r\in\mathbb N$, $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$ any family, and $G$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Let $\epsilon:G[0]\to C$ be the explicit increasing-tuple sheaf augmentation [def-pc-s3-alternating-cech-sheaf-construction]. For every $i:\operatorname{Fin}(r)$, restricting the extension by zero of $\epsilon$ from natural to integer degrees to $U_i$ is a homotopy equivalence of complexes of $\mathcal O_{U_i}$-modules. No covering condition and no pullback morphism are assumed.

source.place: Tag 02FU (local insertion contraction), adapted to increasing tuples using Tag 01FM (alternating comparison); parent local-contraction proof

proof.text: Take a left inverse of the restricted extended augmentation in degree zero from the singleton-retraction lemma. The source complex vanishes outside degree zero; the target complex vanishes in negative degrees. Define a chain morphism q by that projection in degree zero and zero elsewhere. Its only possible incoming chain equation has zero source in degree -1. Check a followed by q equals the identity in degree zero by the retraction lemma, and elsewhere using the source zero objects.

Apply the signed insertion identities to this q. Define the homotopy component from degree j to k to be h_k transported along k+1=j, and zero off that relation. The displayed identities, reassociated and reordered additively, verify Homotopy.comm for a homotopy from the identity to q followed by a. Reverse this homotopy. The other composite is strictly the identity, hence has Homotopy.ofEq. Package these maps and homotopies into HomotopyEquiv with forward map exactly the given restricted extended augmentation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 02FU and 01FM; F4 reduction into singleton retraction and insertion identities, with proved integer-degree support, chain-map and homotopy assembly

theorem alternatingCechSheafAugmentation_restrict_homotopyEquivalence
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (G : X.Modules) (i : Fin r) :
    HomologicalComplex.homotopyEquivalences (U i).toScheme.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
          (alternatingCechSheafAugmentation U G) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
